brand: The Residual Stream · EP 09 · Modern LLMs

lines.text: Vera, are today's chatbots a whole new machine?
Same 2017 recipe, just tuned almost everywhere.
lines.say: Same twenty seventeen recipe, just tuned almost everywhere.

lines.text: Five ideas matter when you build on one.
For word 500, does it redo all the work before it?
lines.say: For word five hundred, does it redo all the work before it?

lines.text: Earlier tokens can't see later ones, so their keys and values never change. It keeps them: the KV cache.
lines.say: Earlier tokens can't see later ones, so their keys and values never change. It keeps them: the K V cache.

lines.text: Three steps: 7 computations instead of 22!
lines.say: Three steps: seven computations instead of twenty-two!

lines.text: Prompt caching: same trick. The catch: it fills GPU memory, often capping users per server.
lines.say: Prompt caching: same trick. The catch: it fills G P U memory, often capping users per server.

lines.text: How do models get huge without getting slow?
Mixture of experts: a router sends each token to a few small expert MLPs.
lines.say: Mixture of experts: a router sends each token to a few small expert M L Ps.

lines.text: Kimi K2 has about a trillion parameters, but uses only 32 billion per token.
lines.say: Kimi K two has about a trillion parameters, but uses only thirty-two billion per token.

lines.text: Huge team, small bill per token.
Longer memory, too?
From 512 tokens in the original GPT to a million and more.
lines.say: From five hundred and twelve tokens in the original G P T, to a million and more.

lines.text: But fitting a book isn't reading it well. The middle still gets missed.
And the models that think first?
Writing out steps helps, and reasoning models are trained to do it.
Accuracy grows with thinking time. Hence the “thinking budget” setting.
lines.say: Accuracy grows with thinking time. Hence the thinking budget setting.

lines.text: And facts newer than its training?
RAG puts fresh documents into the context. With tools, it writes a call, and your code runs it.
lines.say: Rag puts fresh documents into the context. With tools, it writes a call, and your code runs it.

lines.text: Loop that, and you have an agent. That's episode 11.
lines.say: Loop that, and you have an agent. That's episode eleven.

lines.text: Can I try it myself?
Step through the KV cache and route a token in the Modern LLMs chapter.
lines.say: Step through the K V cache, and route a token, in the Modern L L Ms chapter.

lines.text: Remember, don't redo. My kind of motto.
